stories.title: Add comparison workflow to system prompt
stories.description: Update SYSTEM_PROMPT with provider-agnostic comparison flow: when user asks to compare products, the LLM must call get_reviews_summary for EACH product (to ensure opinions/sentiment are extracted), then call compare_products to generate the side-by-side table. Also add semantic_search to the function reference.
acceptance: The comparison section instructs calling get_reviews_summary for EACH product being compared
The comparison section instructs calling compare_products after summaries are ready
semantic_search is listed in the Function Reference section

stories.title: Ensure opinion extraction on cached summaries
stories.description: When get_reviews_summary returns a Redis-cached summary, check if consensus data exists for the product. If not, run the opinion extraction pipeline (_extract_opinions_and_build_consensus) even on a cache hit. This ensures products ingested before the opinion pipeline was added still get sentiment data for comparisons.
acceptance: get_reviews_summary checks for existing consensus after cache hit
If consensus is missing, opinion extraction runs even with cached summary
If consensus already exists, no redundant extraction occurs
aspect_sentiments is included in the return value after extraction
